settle_gated_note: per race (its first market): gate = first publication with >= 1% counted for the race; model = max(model settle, gate); lead = Polymarket settle - gated model settle, minutes (settle = staying >= 0.9 on the outcome to the end of the price window)

reasons.capacity: dollars of real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price in the 30 min after each frozen-rule signal (0 s latency)
reasons.calibration: edge-audit window: minutes with 1-95% counted from the first publication to the end of the price window (6 days)
reasons.capacity.kalshi: computed only where a frozen night config defines the trading rule (Brazil)
reasons.settle.kalshi: Kalshi lists no market on 3 of 6 races: list, margin9, turnout

accuracy.pwin_window: minutes from >= 1% counted until both model and market stayed >= 0.9 on the winner
accuracy.outcome: Polymarket resolution (checked against the official final, 05071600)

profit.rule: frozen night rule: favoured side only, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% of the market counted, first signal per market, held to resolution
profit.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; return at the signal's all-in cost (price + 1c half-spread + taker fee)

invest10k.execution: model limit: after the 1% gate, 10% of every real taker trade (Israel: resting ask in the recorded book) on the favoured side whose all-in price leaves the model >= 5c, using the model P known >= 60 s earlier; no per-market cap
invest10k.note: Single event: every bet depends on the same election-night count, so the markets move together and this is one outcome, not many independent bets. 38% of the eligible volume was in one market (will-the-next-prime-minister-of-hungary-be-pter-magyar). Eligible volume is an upper bound: other traders took those trades.

signal_price.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee (analysis/hu_score.py fills)
